title: Cameron Thomas joins the UGA College of Pharmacy
description: The University of Georgia College of Pharmacy welcomed Cameron D. Thomas, PharmD, PhD, as an Assistant Professor in Clinical and Administrative Pharmacy.
author: Thomas Lab
body_html:
Dr. Cameron D. Thomas joined the University of Georgia College of Pharmacy as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Clinical and Administrative Pharmacy.

His research program focuses on precision therapeutics, pharmacogenomics, cardiovascular pharmacotherapy, real-world evidence, and computational approaches that can improve medication selection and safety.

title: New JACC: Advances publication examines socioeconomic deprivation after PCI
description: A new study coauthored by Dr. Thomas examines post-PCI outcomes in the context of area-level socioeconomic deprivation and P2Y12 inhibitor therapy.
author: Thomas Lab
body_html:
The study evaluates how area-level socioeconomic deprivation relates to outcomes after percutaneous coronary intervention and examines those patterns across P2Y12 inhibitor treatment groups.

The work contributes to the lab’s broader interest in connecting medication effectiveness, cardiovascular outcomes, and real-world patient context.

title: Connecting precision medicine research with rural Georgia
description: UGA’s rural engagement programming highlights how faculty can connect research expertise with communities across Georgia.
author: Thomas Lab
body_html:
Community-engaged research is essential when precision medicine is intended to improve care across diverse clinical settings.

This update highlights UGA’s rural engagement work and the broader opportunity to connect data-driven therapeutics research with the needs of communities across Georgia.
